title: Magpie ideas index (magpie.ideas/1)
description: Every new possibility of every edition, newest edition first, rebuilt on every publish. Each one's page is /magpie/i/<id>; its full text is in days/<date>.json under possibilities.items, matched by id. Fields may be added; existing fields keep their meaning within magpie.ideas/1. The pipeline checks the file against this schema before it publishes: a file that fails is reported and not published, and the last good one stays.

updated.description: The newest edition it was built from.

idea_id.description: An idea's page id: its edition's date and the first six words of its title, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with -2 and on for a repeat that day. Its page is /magpie/i/<id>.

date.description: The edition it is in. The id starts with it.

position.description: Its place in that edition's list, from 1. Absent on a retired id.

connection.description: Why the ingredients combine, in a sentence or two.

score.description: Its rank score in that edition.

effort.description: How long the smallest test takes, for example "a week".

builds_on.description: The earlier possibility it builds on; id is null when that one cannot be found.

built_on_by.description: Ids of later possibilities that build on this one.

retired.description: An id no edition carries any more: its edition's possibilities were worked out again. Only id, date and title remain, so a link to it can still say so.

id.description: The capability's event id in the edition on date. Its page is /magpie/c/<date>-<id>.

date.description: The edition the capability was drawn from: the idea's own, or an earlier one for a library ingredient.

url.description: Where the capability lives: its repo, model, paper or post.
